proposals.before: On renchen Zhang Kai, Duke of Shangdang, and Princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.
proposals.after: On renchen Zhang Kai, Duke of Shangdang, and Princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were raised and made marshals.
proposals.reason: Chinese 起 means raised/appointed as marshals, not recalled from elsewhere.

proposals.before: On renchen Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai and the princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were recalled and made marshals.
proposals.after: On renchen Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai and the princes Wang Yishen of Linzi and Fan Chengjin of Guangping were raised and made marshals.
proposals.reason: Chinese 起 means raised/appointed as marshals, not recalled.

proposals.before: On wei a placard called the people to sell grain and pay next year's military-supply levy; wealthy households' land rent was levied the same way.
proposals.after: On yiwei a placard called the people to sell grain and pay next year's military-supply levy; wealthy households' land rent was levied the same way.
proposals.reason: 乙未 is yiwei; the translation drops yi and reads only wei.

proposals.before: On wei an edict by placard called the people to sell and remit next year's military-supply tax; wealthy households' land rent likewise.
proposals.after: On yiwei an edict by placard called the people to sell and remit next year's military-supply tax; wealthy households' land rent likewise.
proposals.reason: 乙未 is yiwei; the translation drops yi and reads only wei.

proposals.before: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial troops; eastern marshal Gao Xian and fruit-steadfast commandant Niange Yaozhu took ten thousand as vanguard to Pucheng.
proposals.after: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial troops; eastern marshal Gao Xian and Guoyi commandant Niange Yaozhu took ten thousand as vanguard to Pucheng.
proposals.reason: 果毅 is the office title Guoyi, not 'fruit-steadfast'.

proposals.before: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial Army men; Eastern Marshal Gao Xian and Fruit-Steadfast Commandant Niange Yaozhu led ten thousand as vanguard, reaching Pucheng.
proposals.after: Marshal Pucha Guannu led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial Army men; Eastern Marshal Gao Xian and Guoyi Commandant Niange Yaozhu led ten thousand as vanguard, reaching Pucheng.
proposals.reason: 果毅 should be rendered Guoyi, not Fruit-Steadfast.

proposals.before: His brother Yi became participation councillor; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.
proposals.after: His brother Yi became equal-rank minister; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, vice censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.
proposals.reason: 平章政事 is equal-rank minister, not participation councillor; 御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief.

proposals.before: His younger brother Yi was Participation Councillor; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.
proposals.after: His younger brother Yi was Equal-Rank Minister; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Vice Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.
proposals.reason: 平章政事 misrendered as Participation Councillor; 御史中丞 is not Censor-in-Chief.

proposals.before: Revenue clerk Zheng Zhao refused summons.
proposals.after: Revenue clerk Zheng Zhu refused summons.
proposals.reason: 鄭著 is Zheng Zhu; Zhao would be 趙.

proposals.before: That day Right Deputy Commandant Wendun Ali, Left and Right Palace Gentlemen Attendant Yuanlang Nie Tianji, Censor-in-Chief Peiman Ahudai, Remonstrance Official and Department Director Wugulun Nushen, Left Deputy Commandant Wanyan Asan, Palace Attendant Mangge, and Lecturer Pucha Qi were all killed.
proposals.after: That day Right Deputy Commandant Wendun Ali, Left and Right Palace Gentlemen Attendant Nie Tianji, Censor-in-Chief Peiman Ahudai, Remonstrance Official and Department Director Wugulun Nushen, Left Deputy Commandant Wanyan Asan, Palace Attendant Mangge, and Lecturer Pucha Qi were all killed.
proposals.reason: Literal invents 'Yuanlang', absent from the Chinese.

proposals.before: On wuchen Guan Nu mutinied with the Loyal-Benevolence Army, killed Ma Yong, then slew Li Xi, Shi Zannü Luhuan, Tushan Changle, and over three hundred courtiers through the right vice director.
proposals.after: On wuchen Guan Nu mutinied with the Loyal-and-Filial Army, killed Ma Yong, then slew Li Xi, Shi Zannü Luhuan, Tushan Changle, and over three hundred courtiers through the right vice director.
proposals.reason: 忠孝軍 is Loyal-and-Filial Army, not Loyal-Benevolence; the mistranslation obscures the same force named earlier.

proposals.before: On wuchen Guan Nu raised the Loyal-Benevolence Army in revolt, attacked and killed Ma Yong, then killed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xi, Participation Councillor Shi Zannü Luhuan, Inspector Tushan Changle, and more than three hundred attendants from the right vice director down.
proposals.after: On wuchen Guan Nu raised the Loyal-and-Filial Army in revolt, attacked and killed Ma Yong, then killed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Li Xi, Participation Councillor Shi Zannü Luhuan, Inspector Tushan Changle, and more than three hundred attendants from the right vice director down.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise misrenders 忠孝軍 as Loyal-Benevolence instead of Loyal-and-Filial.

proposals.before: Guan Nu lodged above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall, and no inner-court minister dared address him.
proposals.after: Guan Nu made the emperor reside in the Zhaobi Hall, and no inner-court minister dared address him.
proposals.reason: 以上居照碧堂 means he caused His Majesty to dwell in Zhaobi Hall, not that Guan Nu lodged above the emperor.

proposals.before: Guan Nu lived above the emperor in the Zhaobi Hall; none of the inner-court ministers dared present memorials or audience.
proposals.after: Guan Nu made the emperor live in the Zhaobi Hall; none of the inner-court ministers dared present memorials or audience.
proposals.reason: Literal reverses 以上居: Guan Nu housed the emperor in the hall rather than living above him.

proposals.before: In the fourth summer month, on renwu, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu seized Wang Dequan and his son and executed them with partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
proposals.after: In the fourth summer month, on renwu, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu seized Wang Dequan and his son and executed them with partisans Wang Lin, Yang Gui, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
proposals.reason: 楊璝 is Yang Gui (璝), not Yang Jin; the English invents a wrong given name.

proposals.before: Summer, fourth month, renwu: Xuzhou Traveling Secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu arrested Wang Dequan and his son and executed them, together with their partisans Wang Lin, Yang Jin, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
proposals.after: Summer, fourth month, renwu: Xuzhou Traveling Secretariat Wanyan Huxiehu arrested Wang Dequan and his son and executed them, together with their partisans Wang Lin, Yang Gui, and Xie Mao Yanshou.
proposals.reason: Same given-name error for 楊璝 in the literal field.

proposals.before: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and calmed the unrest.
proposals.after: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-and-Filial Army, and calmed the unrest.
proposals.reason: Again 忠孝軍 must be Loyal-and-Filial, matching earlier correct rendering.

proposals.before: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-Benevolence Army, and settled the shaken.
proposals.after: The emperor appeared at the Double Gate, amnestied the Loyal-and-Filial Army, and settled the shaken.
proposals.reason: Literal repeats the Loyal-Benevolence mistranslation of 忠孝軍.

proposals.before: On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang made Fuge military commissioner on his own authority, stopped the armor-and-grain levy, and the prefecture settled.
proposals.after: On bingshen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang made Fuge military commissioner on his own authority, stopped the armor-and-grain levy, and the prefecture settled.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申 is bingshen; English wrongly has bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: On bingchen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang by expedient authority made Fuge military commissioner, halted the iron-armor and grain transport, and the prefecture was calmed.
proposals.after: On bingshen Bozhou garrison commander Cui Fuge killed defender Wang Bin and others; Zhang Tiangang by expedient authority made Fuge military commissioner, halted the iron-armor and grain transport, and the prefecture was calmed.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise misreads 丙申 as bingchen.

proposals.before: On yimao Wei Jun was dispatched to rally Wu Xian’s army.
proposals.after: On yimao Wei Fan was dispatched to rally Wu Xian’s army.
proposals.reason: Chinese 魏璠 is Wei Fan; idiomatic English misreads 璠 as Jun.

proposals.before: On yimao Wei Jun was sent to summon Wu Xian’s troops.
proposals.after: On yimao Wei Fan was sent to summon Wu Xian’s troops.
proposals.reason: Chinese 魏璠 is Wei Fan; literal English wrongly renders 璠 as Jun.

proposals.before: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to flee to Caizhou; Wu Xian chased Zhi in vain and killed Jue.
proposals.after: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jie plotted to flee to Caizhou; Wu Xian chased Zhi in vain and killed Jie.
proposals.reason: Chinese 石玠 is Shi Jie (玠), not Jue; the English given name is wrong.

proposals.before: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jue plotted to return to Caizhou; Wu Xian pursued Zhi without catching him and killed Jue.
proposals.after: Traveling Six Ministries director Lu Zhi and vice director Shi Jie plotted to return to Caizhou; Wu Xian pursued Zhi without catching him and killed Jie.
proposals.reason: Chinese 石玠 is Shi Jie; literal English misreads 玠 as Jue.

proposals.before: On yisi Urgun Hao was made censor-in-chief with his supreme command unchanged; Zhang Tiangang was censor-in-chief and still acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was Pacify-South Army military commissioner and also Caizhou circuit observer.
proposals.after: On yisi Urgun Hao was made censor-in-chief with his supreme command unchanged; Zhang Tiangang was chief censor and still acting participation councillor; Wanyan Yaoshi was Pacify-South Army military commissioner and also Caizhou circuit observer.

proposals.before: On bingxu an edict ordered acting Participation Councillor Monian Udian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to run the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.
proposals.after: On bingxu an edict ordered acting Participation Councillor Monian Wudian and Privy Council signatory Lou Shi to run the traveling secretariat and council at Xi.

proposals.after: On renchen Xi traveling secretariat Monian Wudian with troops raided Song at Zhongdu Ford and took many heads and captives.

proposals.after: On bingshen Left Deputy Chief Inspector Wendun Changsun was killed in battle.
